horizon_height_fog.approximation: No additional height fog; retain actual physical aerial perspective

shader_patch.flat_nwu_horizon_haze: Removed world-horizontal farAP crossfade. Nonstationary background lookup clamps to last physical sky ray above the curved planet horizon; geometry and AP remain actual.
shader_patch.pipeline: Existing forward raster path; visibility compute shading remains off
shader_patch.source_card_backface_normals: For registered source-volume cards only, mirror normal depth while retaining texture tangent/bitangent components on backfaces. Source images, alpha/depth and standard materials unchanged. Opposite-side volume lighting remains an impostor approximation.
shader_patch.source_card_normal_encoding: Exact retained source PNG loaded once per view as linear RGBA8; decode all three averaged normal channels for explicitly marked source-volume cards. No inferred hemisphere, altered source vectors or global normal-map change.
shader_patch.source_tree_grounding: Explicit source UV1 base anchors or source-tree indices with per-instance north/west position streams, shared R32 core height atlas and indexed-triangle interpolation. Same raster deformation in color/depth/shadows and GPU draw-buffer inspection. Static triangle preload shifts current/previous geometry for visibility depth/velocity. Unused partial-batch slots collapse to zero-area triangles. Owned GPU instance copy patches bounds and stream offsets/counts before visibility; indexed raster only.
shader_patch.cache_provenance: Owned-source-v1 cache starts without inherited compiled programs: old copied wishadermeta referenced upstream includes and left shadow variants stale. All compiled dependencies must refer to owned shader-source files.
shader_patch.water_refraction_depth: Retain coarse depth only for refracted UV selection; final attenuation uses the selected full-resolution depth sample. No retained mip-footprint depth bias.

provenance.geometry: Original registered FlightGear exterior geometry retained; F16 adds original source pilot_externalview.ac and Cockpit/Main/cockpit.ac, without new invented geometry or physical changes.
provenance.material_parameters: Engineering paint/glass/metal approximations based on source material names and roles, not measured BRDFs
provenance.detail_textures: Existing registered CC0 grass color/normal/roughness; exact unchanged source hashes
provenance.detail_mean: Computed from source color in linear sRGB to preserve macro mean brightness
provenance.shader_source: Pinned Wicked Engine MIT source copied to cache; upstream checkout not edited
provenance.aircraft_surfaces: Source normals/UVs audited; original exterior positions/indices/normals/UVs/images retained. F16 source pilot and cockpit-main geometry added at their declared identity transforms. F22 exterior-atlas luminance uses configurable linear knee/shoulder/dark-ink lift; source-named F119/vector meshes retain separate metal material. F16 source internal-flame white emissive disc uses non-emissive metal; actual-throttle glow retained. Engineering approximations, not measured BRDFs or a PBR texture set.
provenance.daylight: Sun energy4/ACES; exposure2 selected after fixed-camera exposure1/2 and sun4/10 comparisons. Higher sun elevation and neutral ambient; no additional fog.
provenance.anti_aliasing: Pinned engine temporalAA was disabled; explicit TAA candidate replaces FXAA, subject to actual motion/ghosting review
provenance.canopy: Thin alpha-blended dielectric approximation, linear tint and clearcoat; original zero-opacity F16 inner layer has no depth/specular contribution. Source F16 cockpit and pilot are now included. Not measured optical data; no screen-space transmission blur.
provenance.imported_exhausts: Source FDM capability and existing normalized REHEAT snapshot output required. Source dry engines and unavailable state do not get throttle-created glow. Attachments and emission remain engineering approximations; ordinary F22/F16 retain their separate legacy effect.

scenery_materials.basis: Engineering linear-light albedo for existing stylized Kenney leaf/bark palette only. Source-derived textured pine is unchanged; not measured species reflectance.
